title: lit2bench task catalogue (handout format)
description: One row per task-paper pair, as a JSON list of rows or as {"tasks": [{..., "papers": [rows]}]} (CSV with the same columns is also accepted by validate.py and the scorer). In the tasks layout, fields set on a task apply to every paper row of that task; a row may also repeat them. Rows are flat. Which fields are required is checked by validate.py after the task fields are merged into the rows, because a field may sit on the task or on the row; this schema checks types and allowed values. Extra fields are allowed and ignored by the scorer.

team.description: Optional; the scorer takes the team name from the file name

field.description: Application area / scientific field, e.g. pp, PbPb, GW, multimessenger. Do not collapse pp/PbPb

observable_or_target.description: What is predicted or measured; unknown only when the source is genuinely insufficient

paper_id.description: INSPIRE id (INSPIRE:1234567) or arXiv id (arXiv:2101.01234); the ids Codabench finds in the corpus

recid.description: Optional: INSPIRE record id (exact lookup for the quote check and the scorer)

paper_aliases.description: Optional: further ids of the same study, |-separated

study_group_id.description: Groups duplicate versions of the same study, e.g. sg_<recid>

evidence_text.description: Verbatim passage from the paper; required for supported rows

evidence_location.description: Where in the paper: title, abstract, section: <heading>, page <n>
